Shuning uchun chet ellik ishtirokchi amalda koreys byurosi bilan qo'shma ariza beradi. Shu tanlovning ishtirok shartlari bandi o'qilmadi.
items.eligibility_en: International competition (KONEPS flag 국제입찰 = yes). Under 건축사법 Art. 23(5), a foreign-licensed architect may take design commissions in Korea only jointly with a Korean registered office, and must notify the Ministry (MOLIT). In practice foreign entrants submit jointly with a Korean firm. The competition's own eligibility clause was not read.
items.fee_uz: Taxminiy shartnoma qiymati 1,59 mlrd KRW, QQSsiz (~1,15 mln USD); ajratilgan byudjet 1,751 mlrd KRW (~1,26 mln USD). Loyiha umumiy moliyalashtirishiga 11,6 mlrd KRW davlat mablag'i kiradi.
items.fee_en: Estimated contract price KRW 1.59 billion excl. VAT (~USD 1.15M); allocated budget KRW 1.751 billion (~USD 1.26M). Overall project funding includes KRW 11.6 billion in national grants.

items.summary_uz: Yeongdeungpo-gu, Singil-dong 4960/4961 uchastkalarida, Daebang boshlang'ich maktabi yonida maktab va aholi uchun umumiy majmua: yer ostida 25 metrli suzish havzasi, sport zali va jamoat maydonlari, ustida esa qayta qurilgan bolalar bog'i. Tanlov yopilgan.
items.summary_en: A school-and-community complex on Singil-dong 4960/4961, Yeongdeungpo-gu, next to Daebang Elementary: an underground 25 m pool, a gymnasium and community spaces beneath a redesigned children's park. Closed.
key_points_uz: Yopilgan: takliflar 2026-yil 13-avgust, 17:00 (KST) da ochilgan; 191 ta ro'yxat va 41 ta ish topshirilgan.
So'nggi davrda Seul portalidagi yagona xalqaro tanlov; namuna sifatida kiritildi.
Chet ellik arxitektorlar uchun yo'l odatda koreys byurosi bilan qo'shma ishtirok orqali ochiladi.
Kelajakdagi Seul xalqaro tanlovlarini kuzatish uchun project.seoul.go.kr da nomida '국제설계공모' bo'lgan e'lonlarni qidiring.
key_points_en: Closed: bids opened 13 Aug 2026 at 17:00 KST; 191 registrations and 41 submissions.
The only recent international competition on the Seoul portal; included for reference.
The usual route for foreign architects is joint entry with a Korean office.
To catch future Seoul international calls, search project.seoul.go.kr for '국제설계공모' in titles.
items.verified: partially verified: title, site and counts (191/41) confirmed on the official Seoul portal. The KONEPS notice data (R26BK01568368, 국제입찰=예, opening 2026-08-13 17:00, price and budget) comes via the sankun.com mirror. The program comes from Seoul Shinmun / Yeongdeungpo-gu news. The 지침서 was not read, so the joint-entry rule rests on 건축사법 Art. 23(5), not on the brief. Re-checked 2026-10-15: portal still shows 191/41 (the register button is still displayed, but the KONEPS opening date has passed, so it stays closed).
items.verified_uz: qisman tasdiqlangan: nomi, uchastkasi va ishtirokchilar soni rasmiy portalda tasdiqlandi. KONEPS ma'lumotlari ikkilamchi manbadan (sankun.com) olindi. Qo'shma ishtirok qoidasi qonunga (건축사법 23-modda) asoslangan, tanlov hujjatiga emas. 2026-10-15 da qayta tekshirildi: portalda hamon 191/41; tugma ko'rinsa ham muddat o'tgan, shuning uchun yopiq.
